dishes.name: Aachener Printen
dishes.desc: Spiced, dense gingerbread bars baked in Aachen since the Middle Ages, plain or coated in chocolate. The city's best-known bakery product.

dishes.name: Öcher Reisfladen
dishes.desc: Small shortcrust tart filled with sweet rice pudding and often cinnamon. A traditional Aachen bakery treat.

dishes.name: Puttes
dishes.desc: Aachen's own black pudding, fried and served with onions and potatoes. A hearty old-town staple.

dishes.name: Döppekooche
dishes.desc: Baked grated-potato casserole with bacon and onion, a rustic dish of the Eifel and Rhineland, eaten with apple sauce.

dishes.name: Rübenkraut
dishes.desc: Thick sugar-beet syrup spread on dark bread, from the sugar-beet fields around Düren and Aachen. The region's answer to honey.
